full_prompt_en: A square flat-painted illustration shows a pale girl with long straight black hair standing among oversized blue-gray leaves, holding a black cat against her chest. The girl is centered and front-facing, her smooth dark hair forming a nearly continuous silhouette from the rounded crown to the lower crop. Short bangs frame large, widely spaced pale-blue eyes and a small, unsmiling mouth. She wears a dark green-black dress with a crisp white pointed collar; the plain shape of the clothing lets the face and hands read clearly. One pale hand curves around the cat at the lower right. The cat is almost swallowed by the dark dress, distinguished by a pair of light eyes, subtle whiskers, and a slight change in black tone. A second black cat stands behind her left shoulder, its triangular ears and wide eyes emerging from the plants. Around them, broad heart-shaped and round leaves overlap from all sides. Their colors move through dusty sage, slate blue, soft gray, and pale mint, with thin veins and stems drawn in understated lines. The upper background is a warm off-white, giving the dark hair and foliage clean silhouettes without dramatic depth. The plants are arranged as layered flat cutouts rather than a naturalistic garden; far leaves are lighter, close leaves darker, and the scene retains a shallow picture-book space. Paint is matte and smooth, with restrained paperlike texture and almost no visible brush ridges. Lighting is diffuse and even, with only faint shading on the face and leaves, so the main contrast comes from pale skin and eyes against dark masses. The composition is still, slightly enigmatic, and carefully balanced by the two small pairs of watchful eyes around the calm central face.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形平涂插画呈现一名浅肤色、长直黑发的女孩立在放大的灰蓝叶片之间，怀中抱着一只黑猫。女孩居中正面朝前，平滑深发从圆浑头顶一直延到下方裁切，形成几乎连续的剪影。短刘海框住间距较宽的浅蓝大眼和一张不笑的小嘴。她穿深绿黑裙装，配清楚的白色尖领；简明衣形使面孔和双手易于辨认。一只浅色手在右下弯过猫身。猫几乎被深裙吞没，只由一双浅眼、淡须和黑色层次的微小变化区分。第二只黑猫站在她左肩后，三角耳和睁大的眼睛从植物间浮出。四周，宽大的心形与圆形叶片从各边重叠而入。它们的颜色在灰鼠尾草绿、石板蓝、柔灰和浅薄荷绿之间变化，细叶脉与茎以克制线条画出。上方背景是暖灰白色，使深色头发与叶丛形成干净剪影，而没有戏剧纵深。植物如分层平面剪纸般安排，并非自然主义花园；远叶更浅、近叶更深，场景保持浅薄绘本空间。颜料哑光平滑，有克制的纸感纹理，几乎没有可见厚笔触。照明漫射均匀，脸和叶片上只有轻微明暗，因此主要对比来自浅色皮肤与眼睛对深色体块。构图静止、略带谜意，由平静中央面孔周围两对小小警觉眼睛精确平衡。
style_prompt_en: A matte flat-painted illustration uses broad, clean silhouette shapes and shallow layers of muted sage, slate blue, smoky gray, near-black green, and warm off-white. One large central dark mass anchors the frame, interrupted by a small pale focal area and a tiny bright collar-like notch; additional near-black accents repeat at unequal heights. Oversized rounded organic shapes overlap around the center, their delicate interior veins and thin stems providing fine linework without breaking the calm surface. The edges are crisp but gently hand-drawn, and tonal variation is very restrained. Lighter shapes recede behind darker ones without conventional perspective or cast shadows, creating a picture-book depth. A subtle paperlike grain softens the otherwise smooth color fields. Light is diffuse and frontal, leaving color area, shape, and a few concentrated pale points to establish hierarchy. The overall mood is quiet and slightly uncanny, with decorative repetition enclosing a still, simple center.
style_prompt_zh: 哑光平涂插画使用宽大干净的剪影形状，以及灰鼠尾草绿、石板蓝、烟灰、近黑绿与暖灰白的浅层叠置。一块大型中央深暗体量锚定画框，内部被一小片浅色焦点和微亮的领口般缺口打断；额外近黑点缀在不等高度重复。放大的圆浑有机形状从四周叠向中心，细叶脉般内部纹与纤茎式线条提供精细线描，却不打破平静表面。边缘清楚但有温和手绘感，明暗变化很克制。浅色形状退在深色形状后，不使用传统透视或投影，形成绘本式纵深。细微纸感颗粒柔化原本平滑的色域。光漫射而正面，让色彩面积、形状及少数集中的浅色点建立层级。整体安静、略带诡谲，装饰性重复围住静止、简单的中心。
theme_en: A quiet black-haired girl holding a black cat amid muted blue-gray leaves
theme_zh: 灰蓝叶丛中，一名安静的黑发女孩抱着黑猫
name: Kelly Beeman
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
